title.narrative: International Monitoring Operation (IMO): Support to the process of temporary re-evaluation of Judges and Prosecutors in Albania - Phase III Annual Action Plan in favour of Albania for 2022

description.narrative: Contract related to: International Monitoring Operation (IMO): Support to the process of temporary re-evaluation of Judges and Prosecutors in Albania - Phase III Annual Action Plan in favour of Albania for 2022 - The action aims at contributing to the strengthening of the independence, transparency, efficiency, accountability and of public trust in the Albanian justice system. It envisages the continuation of the International Monitoring Operation (IMO), started under the AAP 2016 with a Phase I of the project. In particular, IMO will ensure that the monitoring of the re-evaluation of Judges and Prosecutors in Albania (¿the vetting¿) by the vetting bodies, is carried out until the end of the process, in line with their renewed constitutional mandate and the Law No.84/2016 of 30.8.2016 (Vetting Law). The final beneficiaries are the Albanian citizens, who ¿ as a result of the vetting process and the work of the IMO ¿ will benefit from increased integrity, professionalism, and transparency of the judiciary in Albania. This is will also contribute to restore public confidence and trust in the judiciary, and to consolidate the Rule of Law. The main stakeholders are the Independent Qualification Commission (IQC), the Appeal Chamber (AC), and the Public Commissioners (PC).
